changeSet.author: tchoi
changeSet.comment: Give owners back DELETE on Gallery files repaired by UpdateEmptyACLsForMediaFiles_RSPAC2559 (RSDEV-1438). That updater wrote seven owner permissions but not DELETE, so the owners could not delete those files. Matches only the exact ACL string the updater wrote for the file's creator (byte-for-byte), so files that were later shared or had their permissions changed are left alone. Appends one element; no other ACL is touched.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BaseRecord SET acl = CONCAT(acl, '&', createdBy, '=RECORD:DELETE:') WHERE type = 'MEDIA_FILE' AND BINARY acl = BINARY CONCAT( createdBy, '=RECORD:WRITE:&', createdBy, '=RECORD:CREATE:&', createdBy, '=RECORD:CREATE_FOLDER:&', createdBy, '=RECORD:SEND:&', createdBy, '=RECORD:FOLDER_RECEIVE:&', createdBy, '=RECORD:RENAME:&', createdBy, '=RECORD:COPY:')
